summary: Signal Stage is a multiplayer 3D motion-graphics stage: press P or ROLL to send every viewer through one synchronized camera shot list with kinetic titles and music. A player behavior starts/cuts the shared roll; cameras, the HUD and one placed stage director consume its shared clock, while the director animates tagged scene shapes and drives the soundtrack.
places: places/main/config.yaml (default place, no title) - 3D stage with terrain off, dark fog/sky and spawn at (0, 0.1, 16); stage objects are in cells x0z0 and x0z-1.
roots: world.config.yaml - world wiring: multiplayer, main place, player/camera templates, arrival hook, lighting, HUD/nametag and cine/jump/movement inputs.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - the 76-object stage: director, title, lights, tagged motion-graphics shapes and effects.
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene - three additional placed stage objects (gz-10, gz-8, gz-9).
templates/player.js#player - character body with humanoid locomotion and player movement/input behaviors.
templates/camera.js#camera - custom look-orientation camera; scripts/camera.js switches to the shared cinematic view during a roll.
scripts/ui.js - viewer HUD for starting/cutting a roll and showing its letterbox, word and progress.
shared: scripts/lib/cine.js - common cinematic clock, shot/camera/title lookup and beat envelope used by camera, stage and HUD.
scripts/lib/data/cinematic.yml - editable duration, bpm, music, idle title, camera/word keys and title schedule for the whole roll.
scripts/lighting.js - world-configured lighting function for lit surfaces; scripts/look-default.js is the place's screen-look pass.
scripts/lib/data/player.yml and scripts/lib/data/camera.yml - movement tuning and first-person eye-height data for player/camera behavior.
notableExports: scripts/camera.js - exports finiteNumber, update; scripts/stage.js - exports update.
scripts/lib/cine.js - exports CINE, cineTime, shotAt, cameraAt, titleAt, beatEnv.
scripts/ui.js - exports default; scripts/arrival.js - exports onArrive, onLeave; ui/nametag.js - exports default.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - exports sit, onInput, update; sim.js - exports cadence, tick.
scripts/lighting.js - exports lighting; scripts/look-default.js - exports look.
ownership: scripts/player.js - handles player movement and writes world.state.cine on cine input (start timestamp and initiator, or null to cut).
scripts/stage.js on the placed director - owns director session rate, its state.track/audio playback, and title.state.line; writes motion transforms for tagged stage objects.
scripts/camera.js / templates/camera.js - camera-local rolling session and look orientation; camera reads world.state.cine for the shared shot, then returns control to look input.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - avatar sitting, turning and movement-driven animation; local gait scratch is in its namespaced session entry.
places/main/config.yaml - place atmosphere, spawn, gravity and terrain mode; world.config.yaml - world-level inputs and service/template wiring.
scripts/ui.js and ui/nametag.js - presentation only: per-viewer cinematic HUD and player tags, not shared cinematic state.
flows: world.config.yaml cine action (P) → scripts/player.js onInput → world.state.cine = {start, by} or null; start is scheduled 300 ms ahead for room-wide synchronization.
world.state.cine + scripts/lib/data/cinematic.yml → scripts/lib/cine.js cineTime/cameraAt → each scripts/camera.js update flies its viewer through the same shot list, then restores look control.
world.state.cine → scripts/ui.js render → idle ROLL button or rolling letterbox, current shot word, progress and CUT button; both buttons send cine action.
world.state.cine + cinematic bpm/music → placed director scripts/stage.js → synchronized stage rate/beat motion and non-spatial audio with shared timeAt playhead.
scripts/stage.js → title object state.line; scripts/stage.js queries tag mg → reads each shape's state.motion and writes its rotation, scale and/or position.
world.config.yaml inputs (WASD axes, space jump) → scripts/player.js onInput/update → character feetPosition/velocity; player template also runs humanoid locomotion.
templates/camera.js orientation.source look → scripts/camera.js update for ordinary first-person look; world.config.yaml arrival behavior → scripts/arrival.js onArrive/onLeave.
world.config.yaml lighting / ui.render / nametag → scripts/lighting.js, scripts/ui.js / ui/nametag.js for shading, viewer HUD / changed player tags.
behaviorFamilies: The mg-tagged shapes in places/main/cells/x0z0.scene are driven by one scripts/stage.js director; state.motion varies spin, beat pulse/phase and orbit per shape, with base pose/size where specified.
templates/player.js composes scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js and scripts/player.js on the character; locomotion owns gait/animation while player.js owns movement input and body motion.
probableOrphans: scripts/flat-starter-terrain.js - old heightmap generator; main terrain is now explicitly off.
scripts/flower.js, scripts/grass.js, scripts/grass-look.js and scripts/pebble.js - old meadow decoration geometry/material; no decoration layers are configured in the current place.
scripts/lib/data/world.yml - terrain baseHeight data with no active terrain consumer apparent in the current tree.
migrationNotes: world.state.cine is the shared cinematic clock; keep it as the single start/cut source so each camera, HUD and stage director stays synchronized. The 300 ms lead is intentional.
scripts/lib/cine.js interprets start and ctx.now() in milliseconds, while cinematic keys/duration and camera motion use seconds; bpm drives beats via seconds * bpm / 60.
scripts/stage.js expects the placed director and title objects by id, and animates only shapes tagged mg with their motion parameters in scene state.
The stage audio is non-spatial and is played by the one director from world.state.cine.start; avoid adding per-camera music playback.
Player movement and world heights use metres; the player template default feetPosition y=2 differs from main place spawn (0, 0.1, 16), with gravity y=-24 and +Y up.
The camera template's orientation.source is look; cinematic flight temporarily authors yaw/pitch and scripts/camera.js restores look orientation at the end or cut.
